To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new electro hydraulic servo system is developed and an adaptive robust integral sliding-mode pitch angle controller is designed to improve the pitch angle control performance and hence to smooth the generator power fluctuations of wind turbine.
an adaptive robust integral sliding-mode pitch angle controller is proposed to improve pitch angle tracking performance and hence to reduce the generator power fluctuations for a wind turbine.
a variable speed hydraulic motor is employed to directly achieve the final pitch angle through a gear set.
In summary, our research is concerned with
an innovative electro hydraulic pitch system design for wind turbines.
the design and implementation of a new electro hydraulic servo system and a pitch angle control strategy for wind turbine applications.
the design of a new electro hydraulic pitch system and the pitch angle control for wind turbines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed adaptive robust integral sliding model control method is effective and efficient for wind turbines.

the proposed adaptive robust integral sliding model controller and the adaptation scheme have been proven to be a very efficient and robust pitch angle control method for the electro hydraulic servo pitch systems.
the pitch angle controller and the adaptive scheme proposed in this paper are effective and practical in practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed electro hydraulic servo pitch angle system and its controller can be a good choice to achieve accurate pitch angle control and hence to smooth power fluctuations for wind turbine applications.
the proposed pitch system with the proposed controller is able to achieve the accurate pitch angle control and smooth generator power fluctuations.
the proposed pitch system and pitch angle controller are suitable for the pitch angle control and the generator power control of wind turbines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed pitch controller can be easily applied to other hydraulic servo systems for the pitch control of wind turbines.

the proposed adaptive robust integral sliding model control scheme with the projection type adaptation law can effectively improve the pitch angle tracking and hence the generator power tracking performances for the electro hydraulic servo pitch systems of wind turbines.
the pitch angle controller and the adaptation scheme have their achievable performances and hence can be applied in practice to improve the performances of pitch angle control for wind turbines.
